cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Reveal the Truth in Layers
cards.instruction: Protect someone by disclosing the truth in stages, changing what each earlier statement appears to mean.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. The wedding venue has made a small change.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. The date remains available. The building does not.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A fire. Let's hold onto the available date while we choose what comes next.

mechanism: Copy a planner's document handling without understanding its purpose, then use that borrowed composure to reveal a wedding-venue disaster in protective stages.
confusable: Not only concealing a letter: each disclosed stage must alter the earlier reassurance, while the copied handling supplies A's method of pacing it.
comparison: A couple faces venue loss; alternative b uses packaging to soften news of a broken keepsake.
seedUse: Retains available date/unavailable building/fire stages; adds wrong interpretation of a planner's face-down page.
